claims.label: filter (discardHeavy)
claims.claim: A method of filtering a catalog of widgets, comprising: receiving a catalog of widgets each having a name and a weight; discarding each widget whose weight exceeds a threshold weight read from a configuration file; sorting the remaining widgets by the length of the name; and emitting a report of the ten longest names together with a timestamp of the run.

dependents.text: The method of claim 1, wherein the threshold weight defaults to forty when the configuration file names no threshold.
The method of claim 1, wherein the report is written in JSON.
The method of claim 1, wherein the catalog is read from a compressed archive.

grounded.element: receiving a catalog of widgets each having a name and a weight
discarding each widget whose weight exceeds a threshold weight
sorting the remaining widgets by the length of the name
the threshold weight defaults to forty

claims.claim: A method of sending mail, comprising: composing a message; and delivering the message over a network.

grounded.element: delivering the message over a network
